theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_ds_fderiv_dirDeriv_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 v U → ∀ x ∈ U, fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ v z e) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x e
